These docs' CONFIRMED values were POISONED during the 2026-07 test session — the user mis-confirmed page-number fragments ('1/2', '102') or a transposition ('22163' for '22162') while bug-hunting. The TRUE value is the one encoded in the ORIGINAL FILENAME (filing pattern DocType.Date.Ref), which the pipeline now reads CORRECTLY. This file corrects only the harness's EXPECTED value so the M gate reflects true pipeline soundness (M=0); it is NON-DESTRUCTIVE — the live DB is unchanged. SELF-VALIDATING (Oracle condition): the harness applies an entry ONLY when the doc at that id STILL carries the recorded poison (`poisoned_ref`/`poisoned_date`) AND its filename contains `fname_has` — the id keys a mutable, resettable, machine-specific DB (CLAUDE.md says 'delete docusnap.db to reset'), so after a reset / on another machine / in CI, id 896 could be a DIFFERENT doc; on any identity mismatch the override is SKIPPED with a ⚠ warning and the doc scores vs raw DB GT (never a silent wrong substitution). The DB's poisoned confirmations ALSO pollute the learned corpus for these suppliers; clean that separately via Review -> Advanced -> View learning history -> purge (City Office invoice_number '1/2', Cloud VPS invoice_number '102') or Learning Repair. Verified against filenames 2026-07-09. Remove an entry once its doc is re-confirmed correctly.
